mapper.sql: WITH emp20 AS ( SELECT t.* , f_cdnm('leaveCode' , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS emp20_leave_nm FROM ( SELECT emp20_leave_id , emp20_person_id , emp20_company_id , emp20_leave_cd , emp20_reg_date , emp20_start_date , emp20_close_date , emp20_leave_count , emp20_reason , emp20_manager_nm , emp20_appr_id , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , emp20_over_confirmer_id , emp20_over_confirm_date FROM emp20_leave LEFT JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp20_appr_id WHERE emp20_person_id = #{personId} AND ( COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'99') NOT IN ('40','99') OR COALESCE(emp20_over_confirm_status_cd, '00') != '00' ) UNION ALL SELECT emp24_joint_leave_id AS emp20_leave_id , #{personId} AS emp20_person_id , emp24_company_id AS emp20_company_id , '01' AS emp20_leave_cd , apr01_reg_date AS emp20_reg_date , emp24_start_date AS emp20_start_date , emp24_close_date AS emp20_close_date , f_get_biz_days(emp24_company_id, emp24_start_date, emp24_close_date) AS emp20_leave_count , '[공동연차]'||emp24_reason AS emp20_reason , null AS emp20_manager_nm , emp24_appr_id AS emp20_appr_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirmer_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_date FROM emp24_joint_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp24_appr_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = #{personId} WHERE emp24_company_id = emp01_company_id AND apr01_status_cd = '30' /* 상신상태(30:완료) */ AND emp01_hire_date < emp24_start_date AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp28_joint_leave_except WHERE emp28_joint_leave_id = emp24_joint_leave_id AND emp28_person_id = emp01_person_id ) UNION ALL /* AssetERP 시스템 사용전 휴가사용내역 (2023.07.24 CYY)*/ SELECT emp27_leave_old_id AS emp20_leave_id , emp27_person_id AS emp20_person_id , emp27_company_id AS emp20_company_id , emp27_leave_cd AS emp20_leave_cd , emp27_reg_date AS emp20_reg_date , emp27_start_date AS emp20_start_date , emp27_close_date AS emp20_close_date , emp27_leave_count AS emp20_leave_count , '['||emp27_note||']'||CASE WHEN COALESCE(emp27_reason,'') = '' THEN '' ELSE '-'||emp27_reason END AS emp20_reason , null AS emp20_manager_nm , 0 AS emp20_appr_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_status_cd , null AS emp20_over_confirmer_id , null AS emp20_over_confirm_date FROM emp27_leave_old WHERE emp27_person_id = #{personId} ) t WHERE ( ( emp20_start_date BETWEEN f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'1') AND f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') ) or ( emp20_close_date BETWEEN f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'1') AND f_get_close_date(emp20_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') ) ) ) SELECT a.emp20_leave_id AS leave_id , a.emp20_person_id AS person_id , a.emp20_appr_id AS appr_id , a.emp20_start_date AS start_date , a.emp20_close_date AS close_date , a.emp20_leave_nm AS leave_name , a.emp20_leave_count AS leave_count , a.emp20_manager_nm AS manager_name , a.emp20_reason AS reason , CASE WHEN emp20_appr_id = 0 THEN '30' ELSE COALESCE(apr01_status_cd,'00') END AS appr_status_code , CASE WHEN emp20_appr_id = 0 THEN '해당없음' ELSE f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) END AS appr_status_name , a.emp20_over_confirm_status_cd AS over_confirm_status_code , f_cdnm('StatusCode' , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS over_confirm_status_name , CASE WHEN emp20_over_confirmer_id IS NULL THEN null ELSE f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_over_confirmer_id) END AS over_confirmer_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(emp20_over_confirm_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS over_confirm_date_str FROM emp20 a LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = a.emp20_appr_id ORDER BY emp20_start_date DESC, emp20_leave_id
mapper.select:
SELECT a.total_days AS total_days , a.py_remain_month_days AS py_remain_month_days , a.use_days AS use_days , (a.total_days + a.py_remain_month_days) - a.use_days AS remain_days , to_char(f_get_close_date(a.emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'1'),'yyyy-mm-dd') || ' ~ ' || to_char(f_get_close_date(a.emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2'),'yyyy-mm-dd') AS std_period , etc.total_days AS etc_total_days , etc.use_days AS etc_use_days , etc.remain_days AS etc_remain_days FROM ( SELECT emp01_person.* , CASE WHEN f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2') < DATE_TRUNC('month', f_today()) THEN f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'1',f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id,#{stdYear},'2'),'true') ELSE f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'1',f_today(),'true') END AS total_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'2',null,'true') AS use_days , CASE WHEN f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar, '2') = f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(emp02_hire_date_leave_calc,emp01_hire_date),'YYYY'), '2') THEN GREATEST(f_get_leave_days( emp01_person_id , (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar , '3' , f_get_close_date(emp01_company_id, (#{stdYear}::numeric - 1)::varchar, '2') , 'true'), 0) ELSE 0 END AS py_remain_month_days FROM emp01_person INNER JOIN emp02_others ON emp02_person_id = emp01_person_id WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} ) a CROSS JOIN
( SELECT f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'7',f_today(),'true') AS total_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'8',null,'true') AS use_days , f_get_leave_days2(emp01_person_id,#{stdYear},'9',null,'true') AS remain_days FROM emp01_person WHERE emp01_person_id = #{personId} ) etc

SELECT COALESCE(sys01_leave_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS leave_yn , COALESCE(sys01_leave_confirm_yn, 'false') = 'true' AS leave_confirm_yn , sys01_leave_month_cd AS leave_month_code FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = #{companyId}

SELECT emp20_leave_id AS leave_id , emp20_person_id AS person_id , emp20_appr_id AS appr_id , emp20_start_date AS start_date , emp20_close_date AS close_date , f_cdnm('leaveCode', emp20_leave_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS leave_name , emp20_leave_count AS leave_count , emp20_manager_nm AS manager_name , emp20_reason AS reason , apr01_status_cd AS appr_status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS appr_status_name , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd AS over_confirm_status_code , f_cdnm('StatusCode' , emp20_over_confirm_status_cd, emp20_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS over_confirm_status_name , f_emp_kor_nm(emp20_over_confirmer_id) AS over_confirmer_name , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(emp20_over_confirm_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), ''::text) AS over_confirm_date_str FROM emp20_leave LEFT OUTER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp20_appr_id WHERE emp20_leave_id = #{leaveId} AND emp20_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys99_print ( sys99_print_id, sys99_company_id, sys99_person_id, sys99_window_class_nm, sys99_group_id , sys99_date01, sys99_date02, sys99_string01, sys99_double01, sys99_string02, sys99_string03, sys99_string04 ) SELECT f_create_seq(), #{companyId}, #{printPersonId}, #{windowClassName}, #{groupId} , s.start_date, s.close_date, COALESCE(s.leave_name, ''), COALESCE(s.leave_count, 0) , COALESCE(s.manager_name, ''), COALESCE(s.reason, ''), COALESCE(s.appr_status_name, '') FROM () s
mapper.select: SELECT emp22_etc_leave_id AS etc_leave_id , emp22_reason AS reason , emp22_start_date AS start_date , emp22_close_date AS close_date , emp22_days AS days , COALESCE(emp20.use_days,0) AS use_days , emp22_days - COALESCE(emp20.use_days,0) AS remain_days , emp22_note AS note FROM emp22_etc_leave INNER JOIN apr01_appr ON apr01_appr_id = emp22_appr_id AND apr01_status_cd LIKE '30' INNER JOIN emp23_etc_leave_person ON emp23_etc_leave_id = emp22_etc_leave_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(emp20_leave_count) use_days FROM emp20_leave WHERE emp20_etc_leave_id = emp22_etc_leave_id AND emp20_person_id = #{personId} ) emp20 ON TRUE WHERE emp22_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp23_person_id = #{personId} AND #{stdYear} BETWEEN to_char(emp22_start_date,'yyyy') AND to_char(emp22_close_date,'yyyy') ORDER BY emp22_start_date, emp22_close_date
